# Resource: tfe_stack

Defines a Stack resource.

~> **Note:** A stack may not be destroyed until all resources within its deployments have been destroyed.

~> **Note:** Stack support is currently pre-release/beta and subject to change.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.oauthClient.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeOrganization.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeAgentPool.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.stack.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        /*Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
            You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables*/
        TerraformVariable githubToken = TerraformVariable.Builder.create(this, "github_token")
                .description("An access token for github")
                .build();
        OauthClient tfeOauthClientTest = new OauthClient(this, "test", new OauthClientConfig()
                .apiUrl("https://api.github.com")
                .httpUrl("https://github.com")
                .oauthToken(githubToken.getStringValue())
                .organization("my-example-org")
                .serviceProvider("github")
                );
        DataTfeOrganization dataTfeOrganizationOrganization =
        new DataTfeOrganization(this, "organization", new DataTfeOrganizationConfig()
                .name("my-example-org")
                );
        DataTfeAgentPool dataTfeAgentPoolAgentPool = new DataTfeAgentPool(this, "agent-pool", new DataTfeAgentPoolConfig()
                .name("my-example-agent-pool")
                .organization(Token.asString(dataTfeOrganizationOrganization.getName()))
                );
        new Stack(this, "test-stack", new StackConfig()
                .agentPoolId(Token.asString(dataTfeAgentPoolAgentPool.getId()))
                .description("A Terraform Stack using two components with two environments")
                .name("my-stack")
                .projectId(Token.asString(dataTfeOrganizationOrganization.getDefaultProjectId()))
                .speculativeEnabled(true)
                .vcsRepo(List.of(Map.of(
                        "branch", "main",
                        "identifier", "my-github-org/stack-repo",
                        "oauthTokenId", Token.asString(tfeOauthClientTest.getOauthTokenId()))))
                );
    }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Stack.
- `projectId` (String) ID of the project that the Stack belongs to.

### Optional

- `agentPoolId` (String) The ID of an agent pool to assign to the stack.
- `description` (String) Description of the Stack.
- `migration` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Stack is created in migration mode.
- `speculativeEnabled` (Boolean) Whether this Stack allows automatic speculative plans. Setting this to `true` will allow Terraform to run plans on pull requests. Defaults to `false`.
- `triggerPatterns` (List of String) List of trigger patterns for the Stack.
- `vcsRepo` (Block, Optional) VCS repository configuration for the Stack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vcs_repo))
- `workingDirectory` (String) The working directory of the Stack.

### Read-Only

- `createdAt` (String) The time when the stack was created.
- `creationSource` (String) The source from which the Stack was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the Stack.
- `updatedAt` (String) The time when the stack was last updated.

<a id="nestedblock--vcs_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcsRepo`

Optional:

- `branch` (String) The repository branch that Terraform will execute from. This defaults to the repository's default branch (e.g. main).
- `githubAppInstallationId` (String) The installation ID of the GitHub App. This conflicts with `oauthTokenId` and can only be used if `oauthTokenId` is not used.
- `identifier` (String) A reference to your VCS repository in the format `<vcs organization>/<repository>` where `<vcs organization>` and `<repository>` refer to the organization and repository in your VCS provider. The format for Azure DevOps is `<ado organization>/<ado project>/_git/<ado repository>`.
- `oauthTokenId` (String) The VCS Connection (OAuth Connection + Token) to use. This ID can be obtained from a `tfeOauthClient` resource. This conflicts with `githubAppInstallationId` and can only be used if `githubAppInstallationId` is not used.




## Import

tfe_stack can be imported using an identity. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = tfe_stack.test
  identity = {
    id       = "st-W6k9K23oSXRHGpj3"
    hostname = "app.terraform.io"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

#### Optional

- `hostname` (String)


Resource tfe_stack can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <STACK ID>
# Note: the stack ID can be found on the stack's settings tab in the UI
terraform import tfe_stack.test-stack st-9cs9Vf6Z49Zzrk1t
```
